# Blaine Central Veterinary Clinic

> A full-service veterinary clinic in Blaine, Minnesota offering comprehensive pet care from wellness exams to emergency services.

Blaine Central Veterinary Clinic serves the Blaine and surrounding Minnesota communities with a team of experienced veterinarians including Lisa Martinson and Sina Lindelof. The clinic provides preventive care, surgical services, dental care, and emergency support through both in-person visits and a Pet Health App for convenient appointment booking and records management.

## Core Services & Booking

- [Veterinarian Services](https://blainecentralveterinaryclinic.com/veterinarian-services): Complete directory of surgical, diagnostic, and dental veterinary services offered
- [Book Appointment](https://blainecentralveterinaryclinic.com/book-appointment): Online appointment scheduling system for veterinary services
- [Veterinary Care In Blaine](https://blainecentralveterinaryclinic.com/veterinary-care-in-blaine): Overview of veterinary services in Blaine including vaccinations and wellness exams
- [Veterinary Dental Services](https://blainecentralveterinaryclinic.com/veterinary-dental-services): Specialized dental services including teeth cleaning and oral health care
- [Pet Health App](https://blainecentralveterinaryclinic.com/pet-health-app): Pet Health App for appointment booking, records, and loyalty rewards management

- [Pet Coupons](https://blainecentralveterinaryclinic.com/specials): Current promotions and coupons for flea, tick, and heartworm services
